name: PERIHELION
source:
Perihelion is a visual novel about identity and coming of age. As a human living in a world of dragons, you must navigate new and old relationships alike during your last autumn as a high school student and prepare for your life to change forever.

[From [url=https://fenmori.itch.io/dragongame]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《近日点》是一部关于身份和成长的视觉小说。作为生活在龙的世界中的人类，你必须在高中生的最后一个秋天处理新旧关系，并为你的生活永远改变做好准备。

[来自[url=https://fenmori.itch.io/dragongame]Itch.io[/url]]
